findings.summary: src/v2/cli/run.js:618 — The new startup guard compares raw Git blob bytes with the checkout-based artifact digest. With core.autocrlf=true, a committed, accepted work.md contains CRLF locally but LF in Git, so every start fails with 'commit the accepted work artifact'; recommitting cannot resolve it. Reproduced through the CLI using an in-memory filesystem and real Git-filtered checkout bytes, without writes. Compare equivalent checkout representations or consistently canonicalize artifact digests, and add a CRLF regression test.
